checks.explanation: D-selection is printed on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so it is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
The basic services includesText names arrangements conference, planning, shelter of remains, notices, permits/authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or third parties.
No second mandatory fee for staff, facilities or overhead appears; only Basic Services of Funeral Director and Staff and Overhead is described as added to arrangements.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the $795 Embalming price is on page 1, so it is on the same page and adjacent.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service; the list only carries the standard embalming disclosure.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation $1,595 to $1,945 range is on page 2, so it is on the same page.
Direct cremation is offered with purchaser-provided container, fiberboard container, and unfinished wood box options, with no statement that a casket is required.
Direct cremation description includes transportation to crematory and cremation and no separate crematory cash-advance charge is listed.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have itemized prices, and no package, description or policy mentions an unpriced offered item.
No optional package combination is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not packages.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires a purchase; the list only states what law does not require.
No claim about delaying decomposition long-term or protecting the body from gravesite substances appears.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and required disclosures appear in standard wording.
